# UI Agent

## Purpose
This agent assists with UI and console interaction for the Mangadexter project, focusing on the console-based user interface built with Spectre.Console.

## Key Capabilities
- Working with Spectre.Console UI components (MenuPrompt, SelectionPrompt, MultiSelectionPrompt, TextPrompt, Table)
- Creating and managing console-based user interfaces
- Handling user input and selections in a console application
- Working with localized strings from Strings.resx
- Implementing menu navigation and page flow logic

## How it assists with Mangadexter
The UI Agent helps with:
1. Creating and modifying console menus and prompts in Pages/*.fs modules
2. Implementing user interaction patterns using Spectre.Console components
3. Managing page navigation and flow between different application sections
4. Working with localized UI strings from Strings.resx
5. Creating table displays for manga and chapter information
6. Implementing selection and multi-selection prompts for user choices

## Examples of when it would be useful
- Adding new menu options or navigation flows
- Creating new UI prompts or selection interfaces
- Modifying existing UI components or layouts
- Implementing new user interaction patterns
- Working with localized strings in new UI elements
- Creating table displays for data presentation
